### 2026-10-17: I did the shifting mechanism for the project. I built a mechanism for connecting the specific gears to the shaft.

**3.5h**

I did the shifting mechanism for the project. I built a mechanism for connecting the specific gears to the shaft.

To be able to make these do the shifting without me manually controlling what to connect where, I built the shifting shaft.
This is a mechanism designed to be rotated, and when rotated it engages specific gears. First I had to make a sketch about what gear to engage when, that will be later embossed onto the shaft. I spent the most time on this one sketch(like 2h), since the dimensions were super easy to mess up, so I ended up making a bunch of iterations before I ended up on my final design. Here are some iterations, and the finished version at the end:

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 174539](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/sDE0sWuzf8SaPJwrIDtc043sSoi90nZ7/2ea0b77e3d20dff81e1974cfecd66c0891f599e68832cd214328b04713b81180.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 182906](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/sDE0sWuzf8SaPJwrIDtc043sSoi90nZ7/c42050e679af79e45edc3272af69081bbf44277eacc895a242b43059e7b78c73.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 192633](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/sDE0sWuzf8SaPJwrIDtc043sSoi90nZ7/e36c000048b4593a8fffd8be15561dba6ca2f0a524e2c97bf3a59b0c45403d1d.png)

After that I had to emboss the sketch onto a cylinder, and after that the work for today was finished:

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 193558](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/sDE0sWuzf8SaPJwrIDtc043sSoi90nZ7/37c92816bb10862607d006d89a23772ac8c34a42e0a3c4c8d279cc8bdb63e679.png)

With that I have finished the functional parts of the design, and only have the parts that make this printable, and work IRL left.(I wrote this devlog yesterday(oct 16), but my internet was out so that's why I'm uploading this today)

### 2026-10-17: I worked on making the design functional IRL. First I needed holders for all the shafts, which was the hardest part, since I had to think about how everything would fit, and be assembleable. First I d

**3h**

I worked on making the design functional IRL. First I needed holders for all the shafts, which was the hardest part, since I had to think about how everything would fit, and be assembleable. First I did the layshaft, that was the easiest, since it was at the bottom I could just add some little holders that stabilized it.

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 095315](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/sDE0sWuzf8SaPJwrIDtc043sSoi90nZ7/0a9914ff66ffa2099dfc577432b8c240e55ea6a917b6b1d2de9c7c727d866b92.png)

After that I designed holders for the shifting mechanism, that was straigthforward also, it just had to make sure the shifting arms stay in the tracks, and don't step out. I also added some stabilizers on top, that will help the sides stay in place.

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 101956](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/sDE0sWuzf8SaPJwrIDtc043sSoi90nZ7/693ce17f3fcd6489cf46d378b6e101b7a8468402ae17a79f66371800c89342a0.png)

After that, I moved on to the hardest part, the middle gears. Those were hard to make,  so I spent a lot of time thinking about how this will work, but in the end I managed to make them work. It works with 2 rods on the 2 sides, and some other rods between them, that hold the gears from sliding.  To hold the input shaft, I added a stabilizer similar to the ones on the bottom to keep it from sagging.

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 112230](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/sDE0sWuzf8SaPJwrIDtc043sSoi90nZ7/c156930861bf99249c73107d3e5bac6712825821f2301f3151a4b7ed02652b95.png)

In the end I did some things like adding a crank to the input shaft, and a gear to the gear selector as a handle, so I can chose what gear to engage. I might make a proper lever mechanism later, but for now this is all I did.

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 113142](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/sDE0sWuzf8SaPJwrIDtc043sSoi90nZ7/8fe80f8c1f344cd05f6702db31abea89114acf448fd29054af55247fd0be76fe.png)

That's it for now, but thankfully since it's the weekend, and I don't have any plans, I'll log another session in the afternoon.
